headline: CMS INDUSLAW, AZB & Partners, Duane Morris & Selvam act on Arvind ₹500 crore QIP
sum: Arvind Limited has raised approx. ₹500 crore from a Qualified Institutions Placement, comprising an issue of 99,00,990 equity shares.
detail: Arvind Limited has raised approx. ₹500 crore from a Qualified Institutions Placement, comprising an issue of 99,00,990 equity shares. CMS INDUSLAW advised Arvind Limited on the QIP, including preparation and review of the transaction documentation and offer materials, regulatory and securities law considerations, and other matters relating to the the issue. The transaction team consisted of Mathew Thomas (Partner), Shambhavi Kumar (Principal Associate), Anjanesh Vatsa (Principal Associate), Aman Bahl (Senior Associate), Kirti Gohil (Senior Associate), Associates Khushi Dua, Preeti Gokhale, Anoushka Sud and Anushka Pawar.
